items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: She has played flute and saxophone with Latin Fever, Etta Jones and Chico Freeman

ctx.x: Carol Sudhalter first pursued a career in biology but eventually followed her passion for jazz. She has played flute and saxophone with Latin Fever, Etta Jones and Chico Freeman, and recorded numerous CDs as a leader. Carol founded the Astoria Big Band and is a member of the Jazz Journalists Association.
Carol was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
